'''Sweeda''' was a [[Weequay]] who served as a [[pirate]] in the [[Silvo's pirates|crew]] of [[Captain]] [[Brutus]]<ref name="So Much Trouble" /> during [[9 ABY]].<ref name="SCDate">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> They were abroad [[Silvo's pirate frigate|Brutus's frigate]] when it arrived outside the [[Barrier]] around the hidden [[planet]] [[At Attin]]. After the [[frigate]] had pulled the ''[[Onyx Cinder]]'' aboard they where among the pirates that aimed their [[blaster]]s at the ship. When former captain [[Jod Na Nawood|Silvo]] executed [[Brutus]] with his own [[blaster musket]] they were initially shocked but was ultimately persuaded along with the rest of the pirates by Silvo to accept him back as captain. Later Sweeda was among a group of pirates that fired at the ''Onyx Cinder'' when it was escaping the frigate's [[hangar]] after it had been retaken by a [[Skeleton Crew|group]] of [[youngling]]s. They had [[Color|brown]] skin and long braided [[hair]]. During this time period they wore a red [[clothing|undershirt]] with a brown vest.<ref name="So Much Trouble" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sweeda was portrayed by [[Sydney Rose Walker]] in "[[We're Gonna Be In So Much Trouble]]," the sixth episode of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'', which aired on [[January 7]], [[2025]].<ref name="So Much Trouble" />
